locations.title: Towns, cities or postcodes
locations.description: Where to search, e.g. Leeds, Birmingham, M1 1AA. Use 'uk' for the whole country.

searchTerms.title: Make / model / keywords
searchTerms.description: One search per line, e.g. 'ford fiesta', 'bmw 3 series', 'transit'. Leave empty for everything.

distanceMiles.title: Distance (miles)
distanceMiles.description: Optional search radius around each location.

onlyDealsBelowMedianPercent.title: Only deals at least X% below similar listings
onlyDealsBelowMedianPercent.description: Optional, e.g. 15 keeps listings priced 15%+ under the median of similar cars (same make, model, year +-1) found in this run.

maxResultsPerSearch.title: Max listings per location and search
maxResultsPerSearch.description: Cap for each location + search term.
